# Let's search for all remaining songs and find their release months
# We'll create a helper to match songs by title and artists
import re

def find_song_release_month(title, artists_str, token):
    # Search for the song
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=title, access_token=token)
    if not results:
        return None
    # Normalize artist names from the note (split by comma, strip)
    note_artists = set(a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(','))
    for song in results:
        if song['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            # Check artists match
            song_artists = set(a['name'] for a in song['artists'])
            if song_artists == note_artists:
                # Extract release month from release_date (format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS)
                release_date = song['release_date']
                # Parse year and month
                year = release_date[:4]
                month = release_date[5:7]
                return f"{month}/{year}"
    return None

# Test on the first two we already know
print(find_song_release_month("Lost in the Embrace of Night", "Noah Bennett", spotify_login['access_token']))
print(find_song_release_month("Lonely Skies", "Aria Sterling", spotify_login['access_token']))
